title: الخبيرة التانية: الجارة
style: found-footage horror photograph at night, one weak flashlight beam, authentic old Moroccan medina setting: zellige mosaic tiles, carved plaster and cedar, iron-studded wooden doors, brass lanterns, worn rugs, heavy film grain, crushed blacks, desaturated, photorealistic, absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no timestamps, no watermarks, vertical composition
post_caption: جارتي ما بانتش، وصوت بنيتة كيغني من الحيط... واش كنتي غادي تحط ودنك؟
summary: After the recording, the neighbour vanishes; the song comes through the wall.
cliffhanger: The neighbour stands behind him in his own recording; her eyes are black.

Hero.look: a Moroccan man in a hooded grey djellaba seen from behind

Girl.look: a small Moroccan girl with long wet black hair in a plain white cotton dress

LallaFatima.look: an elderly Moroccan woman wrapped in a white haik, weathered face

scenes.image_prompt: a narrow dark corridor of an old medina apartment building at night, two carved wooden doors facing each other, one slightly ajar, zellige tiled wall, a brass hamsa on a door, a flashlight beam, {style}

lines.text: هادي هي الخبيرة التانية: من بعد ما شفت التسجيل، ما بقيتش قادر نعس.

scenes.image_prompt: an old woman's closed wooden door with a blue painted frame, a pair of worn yellow babouche slippers on the dusty doorstep, a small hamsa charm hung on the door, flashlight beam, {style}

lines.text: جارتي لالة فاطمة، اللي كتسكن حدايا من عشرين عام، ما بانتش من نهار الاحد.

scenes.image_prompt: close view of an old wooden door with an iron bolt shot from the inside, a brass hamsa door knocker, dust on the handle, flashlight beam, {style}

lines.text: حتى واحد ما شافها هابطة ولا طالعة. والباب ديالها مسدود من الداخل.

scenes.image_prompt: point of view of a hand in a grey djellaba sleeve knocking on an old wooden door in a dark tiled stairwell, flashlight shaking, handheld camera, {style}

lines.text: دقيت عليها بزاف. ولاكن ما جاوبني حتى واحد.

scenes.label: الحيط
scenes.image_prompt: a dark bedroom in an old medina house, a bare cracked plaster wall with a carved plaster niche, a floor mattress with a folded wool blanket at the edge of the frame, weak flashlight beam, {style}

lines.text: فنص الليل، سمعت صوت جاي من الحيط اللي بيني وبينها.

scenes.image_prompt: the plaster wall in the flashlight beam, a faint small pale handprint on it as if pressed from the other side, a hanging brass lantern, {style}

lines.text: كان صوت بنيتة صغيرة كتغني نفس الاغنية اللي كانت فالتسجيل.

scenes.image_prompt: point of view very close to a plaster wall, an ear almost touching it, the flashlight grazing the cracks, {style}

lines.text: حطيت ودني على الحيط. والغنا كان كيقرب.

scenes.image_prompt: a dark hallway of an old medina house, a thin line of pale light under a closed carved door, a rolled prayer rug leaning on the wall, the wall beside it slightly bulging, {style}

lines.text: وفجأة وقف. ومن بعد سمعت لالة فاطمة كتقول بصوت مرعوب: اهرب.

scenes.label: الجيران
scenes.image_prompt: a narrow tiled stone staircase in an old medina house crowded with silent neighbours in djellabas and headscarves standing in the dark, faces in shadow, flashlight beam from below, {style}

lines.text: جريت لباب الدار. ولاكن لقيت الجيران كاملين واقفين فالدرج.

scenes.image_prompt: rows of pale expressionless faces of men in djellaba hoods and women in headscarves turned toward the camera in a dark stairwell, eyes in shadow, {style}

lines.text: كلهم كيشوفو فيا، وما كيتكلمش حتى واحد.

scenes.image_prompt: a middle-aged man in a grey djellaba on the stairs smiling slightly in the flashlight beam, his eyes lost in shadow, {style}

lines.text: سولت واحد منهم على لالة فاطمة. ضحك وقال ليا: هي عمرها ما خرجات من دارها.

scenes.image_prompt: an old carved cedar door burst open by force, splinters on the zellige floor, a pitch dark room beyond, flashlight beam entering, {style}

lines.text: رجعت للدار، وفتحت باب جارتي بالقوة.

scenes.image_prompt: an empty abandoned apartment room covered with thick dust and cobwebs, a faded rug, one old low wooden table with an overturned tea glass, flashlight beam, {style}

lines.text: الدار كانت خاوية. والغبرة كتغطي كلشي بحال دار عمرها ما سكنها حد.

scenes.label: التيلفون
scenes.image_prompt: an old smartphone lying on a dusty low wooden table beside a silver teapot, in a dark room, its screen glowing cold blue, {style}

lines.text: وفوق الطاولة، لقيت تيليفون قديم كيشعل بوحدو.

scenes.image_prompt: close view of a phone screen showing night camera footage of a man pressing his ear against a wall, grainy, {style}

lines.text: فالشاشة، كان تسجيل ديالي من البارح، وأنا حاط ودني على الحيط.

scenes.image_prompt: {LallaFatima} standing close behind a man in a grey djellaba who has his ear to a wall, her eyes completely black, night camera view, mostly in shadow, {style}

lines.text: وفالتسجيل، كانت لالة فاطمة واقفة وراي، وعينيها كحلين بالكامل.

scenes.image_prompt: extreme close-up of {LallaFatima}'s pale face in her white haik against a plaster wall, eyes completely black, mouth slightly open, mostly in shadow, {style}

lines.text: ما تدقش على الحيط... أنا كنسمعك. وأنا وراك دابا. واش كنتي غادي تلفت؟
